operations.name: adjust.add
operations.description: Add a non-destructive adjustment layer above the active node. Types include brightness-contrast, levels, curves, exposure, hue-saturation, vibrance, color-balance, black-white, photo-filter, channel-mixer, gradient-map, selective-color, color-lookup, shadows-highlights, match-replace-color, invert, posterize, and threshold. Pass type-specific params in "params". Match color accepts source_layer_id/target_layer_id to sample RGB statistics. Set clipped=true (layer.set_props) to affect only the layer below.

params.description: Adjustment parameter patch. Choose the branch matching adjustment_type for adjust.add, or the existing adjustment type for adjust.set_params; type may be omitted. Only supplied top-level fields change. Nested objects and arrays replace the previous value, not deep-merge. Bounds describe supported UI controls and are enforced at admission: the op rejects fields, ranges, array lengths or a type outside the branch for the target adjustment.

type.description: Optional; must equal the adjustment type when supplied
